generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1%, pre-medical health checkup charges for labourers engaged, PPEs cost etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI at prevailing rates as on last date of receipt of tender.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tender document is part and parcel of agreement.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The contractor shall follow minimum wages act and other statutory acts and its amendments.

The contractor shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time and if any variation occurs it shall be paid / refunded by / to the Corporation against documentary evidence.

The tenderer shall register himself under section 7 and their worker who will be engaged for the work under section 12 of the building and other construction workers act 1996. If not the successful tenderer may do so immediately before award of work.
The successful tenderer shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The tenderer shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.
The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and shall be deducted from the work bills.

The tenderer should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
Tenderer should have independent PF code. The tenderer shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the tenderer makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (CCM)/ BTPS, KPCL, Kudithini-58315, during office hours. Mobile-91416 07198/9986619078
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

Corrigendum/addendum/clarifications, if any will be notified on the e-procurement website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in. For any further information contact Office of The Executive Engineer CCM, Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., Bellary Thermal Power Station, Kudathini 583 152, Ballari (Dist) (Mobile 91416 07198/9986619078), during office working hours ( from 09:30AM to 05:00PM).

The successful tenderer shall furnish a Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) equivalent to 5% of the contract price in the form of e-BG from any Nationalized/scheduled bank acceptable to the Corporation in the prescribed format within 20 days of receipt of acceptance letter from KPCL. The validity of e-BG should be contract period (contract period plus defect liability period) plus one month or e-BG shall be extended until the final bill passed by the division. And shall execute the agreement within scheduled time, failing which will attract penalty.
The work completion period is 04 Months (Including monsoon) and the defect liability period is 12 months.

technicalCriterionList.description: Any reputed individual/company registered as KPWD Class-III and above contractor is eligible to apply and certificate issued in this regard shall be uploaded

The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of contract value) as a prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work such as strengthening/retrofitting work of Reinforced concrete members to an extent of value not less than Rs.19.063 lakhs (Excluding GST) in any one year in the last five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The work done certificate issued from state / central Government / Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the cost of completed works of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year).

The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.38.13 lakhs (Excluding GST) in the last five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant shall be furnished. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the financial turnover of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Strengthening of foundations in mill and bottom ash hopper area of Unit-1&2 at BTPS.

itemList.description: Preparing foundation bed for masonry or concrete in rock portion by removing all loose material by wedging / chiselling and disposing off the same as directed and cleaning the surface with air and water jet including cost of all materials, machinery, labour and all other ancillary operations complete. (Organisation specific)

The exposed reinforcement bars surface shall be washed with water jet followed by appplying two  coats of anti-corrosive chemical of approved brand on cleaned rebars as per manufacturers specifications inclusive of  all materials, consumables, scaffoldings, labors, equipment hire charges, tools and tackels etc., complete and as directed by the engineer in charge.
Epoxy bonding of new concrete to old concrete
Applying pre-packed cement based polymer mortar of strength 45 Mpa at 28 days for replacement of spalled concrete

Crack Groove Cutting: Groove shall be cut using hand held electrically operated concrete cutting machine of 30 mm deep on each side of the crack to form as "U" groove all along the crack to fill the polyester resin/ Epoxy putty (horizontal and vertical cracks). After the groove cutting, the concrete shall be removed from the groove using the pneumatic concrete chipping machine to form "U" groove and cleaned thoroughly using air & water jet. The item includes the cost of hire charges for all machineries, tools and barges and all labour charges etc., complete.

Structural Strengthening with Epoxy Injection Grout - Providing and grouting with two component low viscous Moisture Insensitive Epoxy Injection Grout to strengthen the structure at cocrete cracks. The material having mixing ratio - (Base : Hardener) - 100:60 (by weight) compressive strength of 70N/mm2 in 7days as per BS6319:part 2, Flexural strength of 30N/mm2 in 7days as per BS6319:part 3, Tensile strength of 15N/mm2 in 7days as per BS6319:part 7, epoxy resin based injection grout meets the requirement of BS 6319 & ASTM C 881. The finished cost to include surface preparation, fixing of non-return valve injection packers at concrete cracks, seal the nozzles with polyester resin anchor grout Instant leak plug 0.2kg/nozzle. All the application procedure shall be as per the direction of the Engineer In charge.

Providing and injecting epoxy grout including structuring of crack in the body of slab girder by sand blasting, fixing inlet tube arrangement including cost of materials, machinery required for the work and labour charges etc. complete.

Crack Sealing/Filling using epoxy mortar: Base and hardener of the high strength repair mortar . Epoxy putty shall be mixed using the slow speed heavy duty mixing machine to obtain a uniform mix. The mixed materials shall be placed all along the prepared "V" groove and finished smoothly using the putty blade/ trowel within 30 minutes by using the divers. The finished surface shall be allowed for curing minimum of 24 hours to attain the strength. The item includes the cost of usage charges of all equipment , tools and plants and all labour charges etc

Drilling of 14mm dia 100mm deep holes in existing concrete  on both sides of crack parallelly by using electrical/mechanical drilling machine at 0.20m c/c, cleaning the hole with jet air and water, fiiling hole with injectable epoxy adhessive anchor (Hilti) or equvialent and inserting staples of 10mm dia reinforcement bars of lenth (U) 0.50mtrs including cost of all labour, materials, T&P, materials etc., complete as per specification with all lead and lifts and as directed by the engineer-in-charge. - for staples
Hacking of CC flooring including cleaning for surface etc. complete as per direction of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Drilling of 20mm dia 100mm deep holes in existing concrete  using electrical/mechanical drilling machine at 0.25m c/c, cleaning the hole with jet air and water, fiiling hole with injectable epoxy adhessive anchor (Hilti) or equvialent and inserting 16mm dia reinforcement bars including cost of all labour, materials, T&P, materials etc., complete as per specification with all lead and lifts and as directed by the engineer-in-charge.

Providing fixing of shear links by drilling of 14mm dia 100mm deep holes in existing concrete  using electrical/mechanical drilling machine at 1.20m c/c, cleaning the hole with jet air and water, fiiling hole with injectable epoxy adhessive anchor (Hilti) or equvialent and inserting of 10mm dia reinforcement bars of length 0.15m including cost of all labour, materials, T&P, materials etc., complete as per specification with all lead and lifts and as directed by the engineer-in-charge.

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification.

Providing and applying one coat of acrylic based, polymer modified cementatious compound and cement slurry in the proportion of 1:2 over the dismantled beam concrete surface as slurry coat before plastering including curing including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, curing etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by the Engineer in charge.

Providing and placing approved free-flow, non-shrink cementitious micro concrete (factory premix comprising OPC cement, graded fine aggregates 10 mm down, shrinkage compensating admixtures, superplasticizers and additives; minimum strength 50 MPa at 28 days) for strengthening of existing foundation, including formwork, mechanical mixing with controlled water content, placing and curing, complete as per drawings, manufacturer’s specifications with all lead and lifts complete as per the dircetion of Engineer-in-Charge.

Cleaning gates / hoists / embedded parts to expose fresh metal surface for repainting by sand blasting method as per specifications including cost of all materials, labour, machinery, scaffolding, applying a coat of rust inhibitive compound with all other ancillary operations complete.

Painting with black anti-corrosive bitumastic paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work including preparing the surface after thorougly cleaning oil, grease, dirt and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Providing and laying in position Reinforced cement concrete for all Super structures of building , Road works, Water works, Irrigation works & super structure works of bridges upto 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators. The cost includes all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes , labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (Including cost of formwork). - M30 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work in single section, fixed with or without connecting plate, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Grouting foundations, base plates, pockets and inaccessible locations using free flow non shrink grout mix including cost of all operations such as mixing to required consistency, conveying, pouring, labour, curing etc., complete with all leads and lifts including cost of grout mix.

Fabricating, transporting to site, hoisting and erecting structural steel member fabricated from rolled steel sections like channels, angles, flat, I-sections, plates, rails etc., as per drawing including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, operations such as cutting, bending, grinding, welding, etc., and providing one coat of zinc chromate red oxide primer after scrapping and cleaning the surface, etc., complete with all leads and lifts (excluding cost of steel but including wastage). (For Power House and Allied works)

Dismantling steel work in built up sections in angles, tees, flats and channels including all gusset plates, bolts, nuts, cutting rivets, welding etc. including dismembering and stacking to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Finishing walls with water proofing cement paint of required shade :New work (Two coats applied @ 4.84 kg/10 m²) to give an even shade after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Cleaning the RCC floor or RCC pavement etc  of all sizes inlcuding collecting, loading and conveying the debris and disposing these materials to the designated dump yard  as directed wherever necessary, all labour, materials and machineries with all leads & lifts etc., complete,through tippers/tractors to the designated dump yard & unloading & Levelling as directed including cost of all labour, machineries etc with all lead & lifts complete.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates
